title: Leader's office and press room
made_here: Rooms, stage, podium, gooseneck microphone, desk, bookcases, doors, flags, curtains, TV screens and broadcast cameras are modelled in the build script. The seal, press backdrop, fictional flag, nameplate, city map, TV screens, book spines and rug are drawn by tools/textures_ofis.py; the view from the office window is a render of the v2 neighbourhood (tools/window_view.py).
